articles.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
articles.description: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

articles.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
articles.description: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.

articles.title: Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Leads China's AI Agent Race—But You Can't Download It
articles.description: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

articles.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
articles.description: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
articles.description: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

articles.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
articles.description: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

articles.description: Bitcoin fell near $62,100 as forced liquidations swept crypto markets. ETF withdrawals and a crowded options trade offer a closer look at the damage left behind.

articles.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says

articles.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
articles.description: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

articles.description: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
articles.description: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

articles.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
articles.description: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

articles.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
articles.description: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

articles.title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
articles.description: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

articles.title: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia as Sam Altman Says 'Heroes Have Flaws'
articles.description: Trump would welcome Nvidia’s co-founder back. Altman, who survived his own CEO ouster, sympathizes but stops short of endorsing Huang’s comeback.

articles.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

articles.title: Fed Is Modeling AI 'Super Intelligence' Scenarios, Including Job Losses and a Stock Market Slump
articles.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says staff are studying three possible economic futures for AI, ranging from widespread productivity gains to higher unemployment and a painful correction in technology stocks.

articles.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
articles.description: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

articles.description: Nvidia shares tanked specularly last week amid the Jensen Huang scandal. Is it in for a major rebound? Here’s what the charts suggest.
